name: cadenway-organization-service
description: cadenway-organization-service tooling: 16 cw-organization-* agents (module, domain, use case, endpoint, event, persistence, migration, test and deployment builders plus read-only architecture, contract, security, observability and performance reviewers for the organization service, plus a .github maintainer), 17 /cw-* commands, 13 path-scoped rules, 18 skills, and the guard, git-guard and format hooks.
